Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

pursue verb

an aim, a goal, a right

also strive for, aim at, go after, pursue a career, pursue studies

classical

Hor. Ep. 1.1.72: nec sequar aut fugiam, quae dīligit ipse vel ōdit (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Mur. 55: ōtium ac tranquillitātem vītae (Lewis & Short)

sequor, sequī, secūtus sum

verb, third conjugation, deponent, with the accusative

follow, strive for

The everyday verb “follow” (see follow), which with an aim or a good as its object is “seek, strive for” (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • persequor, persequī, persecūtus sum — pursue steadily, go after

    verb, third conjugation, deponent, with the accusative · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 3.101: quis est, quī ūtilia nōn studiōsissimē persequātur? (Lewis & Short); Ter. Ad. 2.1.9: ego meum jūs persequar (Lewis & Short)

    Follow through to the end: an aim, an advantage, a right at law. Literally “chase” (see chase); also “go through, relate in full” (Lewis & Short).

  • petō, petere, petīvī, petītum — seek, aim at

    verb, third conjugation, with the accusative · also used · classical · Sall. C. 54.5: glōriam (Lewis & Short); Cic. Or. 56: ēloquentiae prīncipātum (Lewis & Short)

    Aim at, seek to obtain; also “ask for”, “make for (a place)” and “stand for (office)” (Lewis & Short).

  • studeō, studēre, studuī — be devoted to, pursue (a study, an art)

    verb, second conjugation, with the dative · also used · classical · Cic. Brut. 322: litterīs (Lewis & Short); Caes. BG 6.22: agrīcultūrae (Lewis & Short)

    Give oneself to a pursuit; its general sense is “be eager for, care about”, and only later chiefly “study” (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • quis est, quī ūtilia nōn studiōsissimē persequātur?

    who is there who does not pursue what is useful with the greatest zeal?Cic. Off. 3.101 (Lewis & Short)

  • ego meum jūs persequar

    I’ll pursue my rightsTer. Ad. 2.1.9 (Lewis & Short)

  • nec sequar aut fugiam, quae dīligit ipse vel ōdit

    and I shan’t pursue or shun what he himself loves or hatesHor. Ep. 1.1.72 (Lewis & Short)

See also chase, follow, achieve.
